title: Current qualification evidence and limits
summary: The line has executable registrar/authentication, Twinkle REGISTER/OPTIONS fixture, lifecycle-isolation, RTP-over-UDP/SocketProvider, observability and Speech-adapter evidence. Dev16 adds outbound INVITE/ACK/BYE but did not claim a fresh live outbound Twinkle/COTS call in that build session.
invariants: Twinkle REGISTER regression covers Contact expires and rport/received behavior.
Digest evidence covers challenge, rejection and accepted registration binding.
RTP UDP qualification is through SocketProvider, not private SIP/RTP sockets.
Strict ooRexx standards enforcement for SIP dev16 completed with zero errors and zero warnings.
Static/source-shape evidence must not be promoted into a live COTS interoperability claim.
procedure: Next live client gate: INVITE a COTS UA, observe provisional response if present, 200+SDP, ACK, bidirectional RTP, BYE and final 200 with Alchemy Log and Instrumentation evidence.
Requalify against the current SocketProvider authority when its exact source bytes are available.
